title: Clearing and Paving with the Roller

texts.text_1: Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
texts.text_2: In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
texts.text_3: While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
texts.text_4: Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
texts.text_5: In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
texts.text_6: Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
texts.text_7: Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions
